Why PhysiV-Lab

A practical learning loop, not a collection of isolated tools.

The platform is designed around the full student journey: discover a concept, test it, practise it, understand mistakes, and return with better support.

The research problem

Laboratory access should not decide who gets to experience physics.

Students in under-resourced schools can be confined to theory when equipment, laboratory space, and guided practical instruction are limited. Existing digital tools often separate simulation, assessment, tutoring, and progress tracking.

Read the domain analysis →

PhysiV-Lab connects theoretical learning, practical action, immediate feedback, and personalised support in one mobile workflow.

How it connects

One architecture. Four specialised contributions.

1

Learn & discover

Structured lessons, contextual search, and AI-supported explanations establish the concept.

2

Practise & assess

Games, quizzes, and virtual practicals turn knowledge into observable student action.

3

Adapt & re-engage

Analytics identify difficulty and trigger targeted feedback, recommendations, and personalised reminders.
